title: alpha-terpineol induces apoptosis in melanoma cells and its underlying mechanism.
authors: Liu, Weijia; Xiao, Yufeng; Zan, Xuejuan; Qi, Jun; Ma, Ting; Long, Qiu; Wu, Bo; Cao, Yu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究α-松油醇通过JAK2/STAT3通路诱导黑色素瘤细胞凋亡，属于纯药物抗肿瘤机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cutaneous melanoma is an aggressive skin cancer known for its ability to metastasize, resist treatment, and result in poor outcomes. With rising global incidence, early diagnosis and effective treatment strategies are imperative. Plant-derived extracts and natural compounds have emerged as promising therapeutic agents against various cancers, including melanoma. alpha-Terpineol, a volatile monoterpenoid alcohol found in pine needle oil and other essential oils, has demonstrated significant antitumor activity. We evaluated alpha-terpineol's effects using scratch wound, Transwell, and colony formation assays to assess migration, invasion, and clonogenicity. Cell proliferation and apoptosis were examined via EdU and AO/EB staining, while flow cytometry analyzed cell cycle distribution and apoptosis rates. Potential targets were identified through network pharmacology and molecular docking, while Western blotting confirmed pathways related to apoptosis. A B16-F10 xenograft model was used to further validate in vivo efficacy. In vitro studies demonstrated that alpha-terpineol inhibits melanoma cell proliferation, migration, and invasion by triggering apoptosis. Network pharmacology identified the JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway as crucial, with Western blot analysis showing reduced levels of p-JAK2 and p-STAT3. In vivo, alpha-terpineol inhibited tumor growth without causing systemic toxicity. alpha-Terpineol may attenuate melanoma progression by inhibiting JAK2/STAT3 signaling, highlighting its potential as a novel therapeutic candidate.
abstract_zh: 皮肤黑色素瘤是一种侵袭性皮肤癌，以其转移、耐药及预后不良的能力而著称。随着全球发病率上升，早期诊断和有效治疗策略至关重要。植物来源提取物和天然化合物已成为对抗包括黑色素瘤在内的多种癌症的有前景的治疗药物。α-松油醇（alpha-Terpineol），一种存在于松针油和其他精油中的挥发性单萜醇，已显示出显著的抗肿瘤活性。我们通过划痕实验、Transwell实验和集落形成实验评估了α-松油醇对迁移、侵袭和克隆形成能力的影响。细胞增殖和凋亡通过EdU和AO/EB染色检测，而流式细胞术分析了细胞周期分布和凋亡率。通过网络药理学和分子对接识别潜在靶点，Western blotting确认了与凋亡相关的通路。使用B16-F10异种移植模型进一步验证体内疗效。体外研究表明，α-松油醇通过触发凋亡抑制黑色素瘤细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭。网络药理学确定JAK2/STAT3信号通路为关键，Western blot分析显示p-JAK2和p-STAT3水平降低。在体内，α-松油醇抑制肿瘤生长且未引起全身毒性。α-松油醇可能通过抑制JAK2/STAT3信号传导减弱黑色素瘤进展，凸显其作为新型治疗候选药物的潜力。
